slot_scores.name: contract_reservations_must_be_delivered
slot_scores.evidence_quote: does this mean that if the cumulative production of a product up to a given quarter is less than the cumulative contract demand up to that quarter, you pay the delay fee on the shortfall for that quarter, and this shortfall can persist across multiple quarters (accumulating delay cost each quarter until caught up)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about cumulative shortfall and delay accumulation, which implies late fulfillment, but did not explicitly ask whether all contract reservations must eventually be delivered or whether demand can be lost.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P1 Product I Q2 restriction explicitly and sufficiently clarified the cumulative shortfall/delay semantics for contract fulfillment, so no unresolved P0/P1 slots remained at stopping.

summary: The agent conducted a thorough clarification interview, explicitly recovering the Product I Q2 production restriction and clarifying most cost and inventory semantics; the only weakness is that contract reservations were addressed indirectly through cumulative shortfall rather than by directly confirming that all reservations must eventually be delivered.
